# Text Shadow

5 tokens in the `text-shadow` group.

| Token | Type | Value | CSS Variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-shadow.2xs` | `shadow` | `0px 1px 0px 0px #00000026` | `--rw-text-shadow-2xs` | 2X small text shadow |
| `text-shadow.lg` | `shadow` | `0px 1px 2px 0px #0000001a, 0px 3px 2px 0px #0000001a, 0px 4px 8px 0px #0000001a` | `--rw-text-shadow-lg` | Large text shadow |
| `text-shadow.md` | `shadow` | `0px 1px 1px 0px #0000001a, 0px 1px 2px 0px #0000001a, 0px 2px 4px 0px #0000001a` | `--rw-text-shadow-md` | Medium text shadow |
| `text-shadow.sm` | `shadow` | `0px 1px 0px 0px #00000013, 0px 1px 1px 0px #00000013, 0px 2px 2px 0px #00000013` | `--rw-text-shadow-sm` | Small text shadow |
| `text-shadow.xs` | `shadow` | `0px 1px 1px 0px #00000033` | `--rw-text-shadow-xs` | Extra small text shadow |
